liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **The Same Thing** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this a definitive performance, noting the band's ability to cover songs effectively; Reviewer praises the jam during this track as an excellent example of early Garcia genius [5][9]
- **Golden Road to Unlimited Devotion** (1 review): This is the only live recording of the song the reviewer could find after years of searching [15]
- **Viola Lee Blues** (1 review): Reviewer expresses strong enthusiasm for this performance, stating words cannot compute the experience [13]

## The recordings

- **gd67-03-18.sbd.fink.10282.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 14 songs; 87 min; rated 4.54/5 by 57 [1]. Said about its sound: Jerry's Guild hollowbody guitar produces a clear, articulate tone, contrasting with later Gibson Les Paul use; Audio quality is passable to unlistenable, featuring volume dropouts and distortion despite decent mid-60s clarity; Sound quality is rated quite good compared to most recordings from this specific time period [6][8][9][10][14]
- **gd1967-03-18.141400.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: soundboard; 14 songs; 87 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1967-03-18.sbd.sacks.1594.shnf**: soundboard; 14 songs; 86 min; rated 4.67/5 by 6 [3]
- **gd1967-03-18.156086.sbd.Flegel.flac1648**: soundboard; 14 songs; 88 min; rated 4/5 by 7 [4]

## Around the show

- Johnny Talbot and De Thangs performed with the band, alongside Ron McKernan on Hammond and harmonica [4]
- The recording documents the band's significant musical metamorphosis occurring by the end of 1967 [6]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd67-03-18.sbd.fink.10282.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by A.J. Fink; source: Soundboard [1]. Also: A version of The Same Thing from this show appeared on the So Many Roads boxset; A.J. Fink patched in The Same Thing and Viola Lee Blues from a higher generation source [1][8]
- **gd1967-03-18.141400.sbd.dalton.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Tim Dalton; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: flac16/48kHz ; Source Info: Master Soundboard Reels > Cassette > Reel to Reel > Dat (16-bit/48k); Transfer Info: Dat (16/48)(Sony PCM-R500) > Tascam DA-3000… [2]
- **gd1967-03-18.sbd.sacks.1594.shnf**: transferred by Darrin Sacks; source: MSR>R>DATs>CDRs>EAC>SHN [3]
- **gd1967-03-18.156086.sbd.Flegel.flac1648**: taped by This came from an anonymous source via CD.; transferred by All post work done by Brian Flegel; source: Master Soundboard Reels > ?? > CD > .wav > flac [4]
